name: AUZiX Base
purpose: Pin the active AUZiX base ABI and runtime substrate so package builds, package installs, live ISO roots, disk installs, and validation containers target one coherent library tree.

build_contract.builder_role: Packages are built in dependency order against the active base release plus a retained builder sysroot/dev substrate.
dependency_order: resolve runtime and build dependency graph
build/install dependency runtime and dev surfaces into the builder sysroot
build dependent packages against that same tree
package runtime payloads and optional dev payloads separately
validate commands and library resolution against the same base release
publish only one preferred package per name for the release lane
feedstock_order: already-built AUZiX package and dev artifacts for this release lane
builder sysroot retained from prior dependency builds in the same lane
Debian/Trixie package metadata and source as reference/feedstock only when AUZiX lacks the package or a planned base/runtime layer is being upgraded

upstream_lock_policy.rule: Every package built for this base release records the exact upstream origin, suite, architecture, source package, binary package, upstream version, and source checksum when available.

dev_surface_examples: gobject introspection typelibs and GIR files
static build tools required by dependent package configure phases
forbidden_patterns: /Programs/<LeafApp>/<Version>/Libraries containing glibc, loader, libgcc, or libstdc++
/Programs/<LeafApp>/<Version>/Libraries containing EFL, GTK, X11, Mesa, OpenSSL, NSS, font, or DBus platform libraries
leaf package wrappers placing dependency RootFS core libraries before /System/Libraries
package scripts assigning one substrate component another component's version
publishing duplicate active package names without supersede metadata

runtime_substrate.known_current_regression: /Programs/EFL/current was incorrectly versioned with the Enlightenment package version; rebuild this layer before promotion.

promotion_gates: no duplicate active package names in the published repository lane
no package receipt or wrapper references /Programs/Libc6/current as a runtime provider
no leaf package bundles core/security/desktop platform libraries into its app-local Libraries directory
EFL and Enlightenment have separate package versions and receipts
sample command probes pass in the validation container
installer EFL frontend and AUZiX Terminal are validated as separate EFL canaries
desktop launchers are emitted only for installed commands that pass their probe
VMID135 and a second virtual hardware target can boot, open rescue terminal, open browser, and launch one GTK editor
